preserved_semantics.meaning: An exact-task current-state snapshot remains available as current workspace context while an unresolved execution route is inspect-before-use rather than direct authority.
Execution memory without a verified positive outcome cannot become direct-use guidance; known failed or blocked execution evidence is do-not-use.
Continuity state, target files, candidates, blocked history, and rehydration evidence can be present without claiming actionable history was used.
A stable workflow with unknown or mixed outcome remains candidate or advisory evidence; only a verified-success workflow can contribute reusable workflow guidance.
A usable current-state or verified procedure target is not removed merely because stale inspect/blocked history names the same path.
Required acceptance checks and unresolved-current-state completion evidence remain visible and are not treated as proof that completion already happened.
The SDK does not silently resolve inspect-before-use memory as Agent evidence unless the caller explicitly opts in.
A pending artifact already present in the current repository state is not rendered as missing work.

mechanisms.reason: Canonical observe-to-guide product path, scope identity, candidate assembly, hard boundaries, guide receipt, and AgentContext handoff remain the online product spine.
Fixed admission, source preference, and final-use decisions remain only as the frozen comparator and fallback until the learned selector proves held-out value.
Contested state, suppression, restoration, rehydration, and controlled forgetting are required hard product boundaries; they do not own final task reward.
Continuity, context, reuse, promotion, and authority measurements remain useful mechanism diagnostics but cannot substitute for verifier-bound task correctness.
Its current kernel scores measure internal mechanisms rather than independent final-task correctness.
The online Product tool-selection and tool-feedback path is connected and remains a compatibility mechanism while verifier-bound episode reward is added.
runLearningLoopLite is reachable from maintenance helpers and test support but is not registered by the current daemon or Product route path.
Append-only exposure, feedback attribution, and effect evidence remain authoritative projections and will link to, not replace, the generic execution episode.
The daemon starts this worker and it controls connected but unused exposure; it remains until a verifier-reward replacement proves parity.
The daemon starts the worker and lite recall consumes its graph candidates, but association strength is not final utility authority.
Admission is off by default and its shadow output remains diagnostic until verifier-bound held-out effect exists.
Lexical, semantic, structured, execution, graph, recent, ANN, and Substrate retrieval remain broad candidate sources.
Fixed action priority, edge weights, score blends, and propagation thresholds remain the frozen comparator until the learned selector proves effect.
Lexical, semantic, ANN, graph, and structured sources remain broad recall inputs.
Generic files, commands, state transitions, and acceptance evidence are online candidate inputs.
Hard-coded task families, lexical recipes, and prescribed next actions must not expand and are removed after the general contrastive compiler reaches parity.
Hard allow, deny, and safety constraints remain non-learned product boundaries.
Observed tool patterns may propose candidates but do not decide utility.
Static prefer and family-tier ranking remains a comparator until the learned selector proves held-out effect.
Synthetic focused test tools are not part of the general product algorithm and are removed after real-task parity.
The existing low-level SDK and AgentContext compiler remain; Phase 1 adds one high-level episode protocol without creating a second decision brain.

real_diagnostic_evidence.allowed_claim: This task proves that Aionis supplied truthful continuity and completion boundaries, but no arm passed and the learned-history path did not execute. It is diagnostic evidence only.

effect_contract.sample_size_rule: Run a 24-base-task design-readiness pilot, then freeze a joint power simulation for the complete hierarchical conjunction before opening the confirmatory panel.
effect_contract.missing_rule: Arm-dependent crash, timeout, cancellation, missing final state, or missing verifier is ITT failure. Only arm-blind external infrastructure failure may replace one full randomized block once.
